changes: Removed automatic packed-format exclusion: suffix, magic, and unchanged automated receipts are descriptive only and remain entropy candidates.
Replaced pre-rotation prefix truncation with a keyed bounded-memory reservoir over the complete held directory stream.
Exposed eligible entries, selected entries, and conservative oldest-unseen epoch age while retaining every existing incomplete-coverage health cap.
assurance_boundary: No explicit authenticated archive-approval workflow is shipped, so legitimate high-entropy containers remain visible and may alert. Large-file/content/time/traversal incompleteness remains non-green.

changes: Wired an application-owned authority through normal GUI/headless ModuleManager construction and a bundled-only bind_high_water contract.
Added smart-deception-custody to the shared independent-high-water domain set and Personal Sentinel default policy.
Added an authenticated pre-commit transition outbox, OS writer lease, and exact one-step CAS/replay reconciliation for outage and lost-response recovery.
Kept gaps, forks, identity changes, ambiguous resets, malformed transition evidence, and concurrent writers fail closed with explicit health states.
assurance_boundary: The provider remains explicit rather than silently enrolled. Same-host administrators can deny service or mutate local evidence; administrator-resistant preservation still requires separately administered append-only/WORM or kernel/hardware custody.
